# yaml-language-server: $schema=sites.schema.json
# LIME EMR site matrix: the setup and plans of every site, in one file.
#
# Written by the Site Matrix app (tools/site-matrix), where each save is a commit by the person who
# made it, and by scripts/site-profiles/extract.py, which refreshes each site's `detected` block.
#
# Under `sites`, one entry per site, keyed by its id (the folder name under sites/ once it exists):
#   - everything above `detected` is decided by people: organisation, status, dates, patient ID and
#     registration, forms and modules needed, integrations (DHIS2...), notes;
#   - `detected` is what the repo configures today. It is generated: do not edit it by hand.
# Work still to do for a site = what its decisions ask for that `detected` does not show yet.
# `orgs` lists the organisations running sites; `vocab` the milestones and integrations to track.
# `how_to_apply` says where each item is configured in the repo. `catalog` lists the shared forms
# (distro ampathforms) with their program, and the key modules with their frontend apps.
# Allowed values: sites.schema.json. Keys starting with x- are free extensions.
version: 2
orgs:
  msf-ocg:
    name: MSF OCG
vocab:
  milestones:
    - id: requirements
      label: Requirements complete
      hint: Activities, forms and metadata signed off
    - id: uat
      label: UAT ready
      hint: Test server available to users
    - id: prod
      label: Production target
      hint: Planned go-live
    - id: live
      label: Live since
      hint: Actual go-live
    - id: handover
      label: Handover / closure
      hint: Handover or decommission
  integrations:
    - id: dhis2
      label: DHIS2 reporting
      hint: Data the EMR sends to DHIS2 through OpenFn
how_to_apply:
  new_site: Create sites/<id> by copying the closest existing site folder, rename its files and artifactId, and add <module>sites/<id></module> to the root pom.xml. Then run scripts/site-profiles/extract.py so `detected` is filled.
  forms: 'Forms come from distro/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/ampathforms (codes F01, F02...). sites/<site>/pom.xml either excludes every form (<exclude>distro/configs/**/ampathforms/**/*.*</exclude>) and lists the wanted ones as <include> entries, or keeps all forms and excludes the unwanted ones. Add or remove the form file there. Decisions are in `forms`: a library code (F11) with its need, short or with a note.'
  custom_forms: 'Site-specific forms are entries of `forms` with custom: true: build the form JSON, add it to the distro ampathforms folder with the next free F-code, add it to `catalog.forms`, replace the site-specific key with that code (dropping custom), then include it in the site''s pom.xml.'
  modules: Frontend modules come from distro/configs/openmrs/frontend_assembly/spa-assemble-config.json. A site turns one off by listing its app (see `catalog.modules[].apps`) in the modulesToRemove property of sites/<site>/pom.xml.
  registration.id_prefix: Prefix column of the MSF ID generator in sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/idgen/*.csv.
  registration.identifiers: defaultPatientIdentifierTypes of @openmrs/esm-patient-registration-app in sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/frontend_config/*.json; the types are defined in sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/patientidentifiertypes/*.csv (or the distro).
  registration.extra_fields: sectionDefinitions of @openmrs/esm-patient-registration-app in sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/frontend_config/*.json; person attributes in sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/personattributetypes/*.csv.
  registration.address: layout.address.format global property (sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/globalproperties/address-template.xml) and the hierarchy in sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/addresshierarchy.
  registration.languages: locale.allowed.list and default_locale global properties in sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/globalproperties/*.xml.
  locations: sites/<site>/configs/openmrs/initializer_config/locations/*.csv.
  integrations.dhis2: 'DHIS2 reporting runs in OpenFn: sites/<site>/configs/openfn/<project>.yaml (workflow triggers must be enabled), with changelog.md listing the version and the forms mapped. staging_project.yaml holds forms being tested.'
  milestones_and_notes: org, status, phase, focal_point, reviewed, environments, milestones, open_items and notes only live in this file; nothing to change in the repo.
